class: Any manual resolution or state change whose premise (what the broker holds) is read from a stored copy rather than from the latest reconciliation, or any multi-strategy recording that mutates some records before validating all of them, lets the platform act on a broker picture that is no longer true or leave a half-recorded run.
mechanism: W-021: record_report refreshed only blocked strategies, so exit/adopt used a stale copy (exited while the broker held 4 contracts; adopted -50 while the broker held -75); after that fix, record_report mutated strategy A before strategy B refused the run, leaving A flagged with no audit.

first_seen.evidence: verifier: 'HOLE: exited while broker holds 4 contracts'; 'adopted active SP -50 while broker -75'

fix: Merged in W-021 (PR #40): every run refreshes every non-exited strategy; resolutions check the latest recorded report; record_report is two-phase; shared-contract resolutions needing attribution refused (Q224).

detection.note: Guarded by the merged W-021 tests; >20 mutants killed across verifier rounds.

occurrences.evidence: stale broker copy used by exit/adopt
A flagged, 0 audit events, run not re-recordable
named-strategy run falsely blocks a strategy sharing a contract; hand-built report leaves 1 audit event and no flag
shared contract A,B x50 with broker 0: share rule invented +50 for A; adopt wrote it and the closing order proposed SELL 100 (fixed fail-closed, Q224)
